Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, and pchembl_value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL3964. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Inner join compound_structures to require canonical_smiles. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL3964, standard_type IC50, standard_relation equals, and pchembl_value not null. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Order by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Limit to 1000 rows.
